D016-D021_h001.question:
It's been a tough few years since my wife passed. I've always been a bit particular, but lately, things have gotten out of hand. I can't shake these awful thoughts – visions of hurting my grandson, things I'd never actually do, or sometimes, inappropriate sexual thoughts that make me sick to my stomach. It’s like a constant battle in my head.

And the urge to clean… it’s relentless. I must wash my hands countless times after touching anything outside, or even just after using the bathroom. I scrub them until they’re raw. My house is spotless; I spend hours each day cleaning, far beyond what's necessary. I also find myself constantly checking the expiration dates on everything in the kitchen and re-weighing my portions for every meal, convinced I've miscalculated and will get sick, or put on weight. I know it seems excessive to focus so much on my food, but these other thoughts and urges about cleanliness and harming others, they’re just as strong, if not stronger. It's been going on for over six months now, and it's exhausting.
D016-D021_h001.options:
A. Bulimia Nervosa
    B. Binge-Eating Disorder
    C. Anorexia Nervosa
    D. Obsessive-Compulsive Disorder
